messages:
cheng: Heads-up — us-west1 preemptible pool (p3-mix) trending high reclaim probability, eviction likely in ~90s. Thinking about runtime handoff pattern.

evict-bot: [ALERT] Preemption forecast: us-west1-pool3 — 90s median. Nodes: 12 affected.

maria: ugh. last time streaming cutover dropped client streams during KV flush. What's our plan? :grimacing:

cheng: proposal: token-shadowing + soft-grace window. Steps: 1) start mirror stream to standby runner with same prefix tokens; 2) let current runtime finish KV checkpoint for active sessions (target 20–30s); 3) switch client token routing to standby when mirror ready; 4) mark request as requeued if not completed by 60s.

tim: That sounds heavier than current requeue. Any perf/cost numbers?

neha: quick math: mirror stream doubles token work for window. For typical 1.2s median token cost it's ~2x for affected sessions only. But avoids client reconnect rate spikes and reduces tail latency.

maria: can we optimize by only mirroring long-running sessions (>10s) and requeue short ones to cpu fallback? So we don't mirror chat pings.

cheng: yes — implement thresholding and priority tags. We'll use existing policy flags: preemptible_handling:{mirror_threshold_ms:10000, requeue_deadline_ms:60000, cpu_fallback_tolerant:true} 

maria: sample config snippet:

```yaml
preemptible_handling:
  mirror_threshold_ms: 10000
  requeue_deadline_ms: 60000
  token_shadowing: true
  fallback_pool: cpu-baseline
```

tim: regen concerns: how to ensure KV prefix alignment? mismatch caused failed streaming cutover before.

neha: add deterministic checkpoint marker: emit CHK:<seq_id> in stream header, standby verifies prefix via first ACK from model runtime. If mismatch -> fallback route.

cheng: orchestrator changes: need an atomic route flip in router serving layer. plan: 1) route mirror, 2) wait ACK, 3) flip client link, 4) drain old runner. We'll add metrics: mirror_ready, flip_success, flip_fail.

maria: can we test on dedicated pool 2 nodes first? I'll open a canary.

tim: +1. Also add cost dashboard for mirrored token burn so finance can track.

neha: ops runbook note: when eviction predicted, set pool draining mode and raise preemptible-critical incident channel to oncall. Command to annotate nodes:

```bash
kubectl annotate nodes -l pool=us-west1-pool3 preemptible/eviction=scheduled --overwrite
```

evict-bot: [INFO] Annotate command recorded by deploy-bot.

cheng: action items: cheng -> runtime PR for token-shadowing (ETA 48h), maria -> canary + dashboards, neha -> runbook update, tim -> cost impact calc. I'll create a GH issue.

maria: assigning to eng-runtime board now. :white_check_mark:

tim: good plan. keep it minimal for alpha.
